name: io.github.AitoDotAI/aito
title: Aito
description: Predictions over your own data with $p and $why, no model training; says when Aito does not fit.

environmentVariables.name: AITO_URL
environmentVariables.description: The Aito instance URL. Optional: without it the server uses the `aito start` profile.

environmentVariables.name: AITO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The instance's API key (a read-only key is enough unless writes are enabled).

environmentVariables.name: AITO_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to enable put_schema and upload_rows. Off by default.
